Good questions

Before your
first great shot.

A little clarity, so you can focus on the coffee.

Do I need to know anything about espresso?

Just that you like drinking it. Your coach starts with your experience, your taste, and your schedule. We’ll cover everything from the first grind adjustment to understanding what’s happening in your cup.

What equipment will I receive?

Your rental includes a premium espresso machine, a precision burr grinder, a compact home roaster, a scale, a tamper, and a milk pitcher. We match the available setup to your space during onboarding; the photographs show example equipment, and models may vary.

How much space and time will I need?

Plan for a dedicated countertop area, a grounded outlet, and nearby water. Home roasting also needs suitable ventilation. We review your space before delivery. Most espresso practice fits into your normal coffee routine; roasting is a separate, more hands-on session.

How does the coaching work?

You get two personal video sessions each month, scheduled around your routine. Your coach helps you taste, troubleshoot, and build your next experiment. Local equipment delivery and initial setup are included.

What happens after my six months?

The initial membership is $200 per month for six months, a $1,200 commitment. After that, you can continue month to month at the same rate or end your membership and arrange a return of the rental equipment. There’s no equipment purchase required.

Are coffee beans included?

Your first green coffee starter kit is included, so you can begin exploring roasting with your coach. Additional green or roasted coffee is purchased separately. Your coach can help you choose beans for the flavors you enjoy.

Your best cup is still ahead.

Six months of curiosity. A lifetime of better mornings.
